messages.subject: Project Onyx — title review allocation
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Data room is open. Single freehold title WM448210, four FRI leases. Plan:
- Elena: title + searches (local, drainage, environmental, chancel) and CPSE review
- Tom G: lease review (Units A–D), focus on rent reviews, breaks and alienation
- Me: contract and transfer

Key watch items so far: charge to Pennine Business Bank (needs discharge), Unit D break/expiry 2028 and the rent arrears flagged in the replies. Aim to get the draft report on title to the client by end of Feb.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0531
